items: 𝗛𝗘𝗔𝗩𝗬-𝗗𝗨𝗧𝗬 𝗠𝗘𝗧𝗔𝗟 𝗢𝗕𝗘𝗟𝗜𝗦𝗞 𝗧𝗥𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗦 - Create a focal point in the garden with our exclusive and visually striking steel trellis. Crafted from robust metal, this garden obelisk trellis offers unparalleled stability to support climbing plants. Powder coated to be weatherproof and waterproof, resisting rust. Includes stainless steel hardware to withstand the elements

𝗥𝗨𝗦𝗧𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗢𝗙 & 𝗪𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗛𝗘𝗥-𝗥𝗘𝗦𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧 - Built with thick, powder-coated steel tubing, this obelisk trellis resists rust and extreme weather, ensuring long-lasting durability without rust or corrosion - perfect for year-round gardening. Recommend to firmly insert the trellis 3" into the soil for exceptional stability, keeping your plants secure and grow upright

𝗦𝗣𝗔𝗖𝗘-𝗦𝗔𝗩𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗙𝗢𝗥 𝗦𝗠𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗚𝗔𝗥𝗗𝗘𝗡𝗦 - Measuring 63"H x 10.5"W, the vertical tower obelisk maximizes space, ideal for small outdoor areas. The vertical trellising improves air circulation and sun exposure while simplifying harvesting. Our metal trellis supports upward plant growth and also serves as a plant trellis for climbing plants indoor

𝗘𝗟𝗘𝗚𝗔𝗡𝗧 & 𝗘𝗫𝗤𝗨𝗜𝗦𝗜𝗧𝗘 𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗘𝗔𝗥𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘 - This trellis combines functionality with elegance. Enhance your patio or balcony garden’s aesthetics while providing sturdy support for climbing roses, beans, or cucumbers. A timeless addition to modern or rustic outdoor spaces even without plants. As an indoor plant trellis, the design elevates houseplants and provides structure for growth

𝗩𝗘𝗥𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗟𝗘 𝗨𝗦𝗘 & 𝗘𝗔𝗦𝗬 𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗘𝗠𝗕𝗟𝗬 - Enhance the growth of roses, clematis, ivy, jasmine, morning glory, tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, blackberries, beans, grapevines, long stems, fruit vines, houseplants, etc. Ideal for tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers - reduces ground rot and boosts accessibility. The trellis for potted plants obelisk is simple to assemble and disassemble. Weighing just 3 pounds, the house plant trellis is lightweight and portable
